description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダムＵＣ』より、EWACジェガンが待望のHGUCキット化！
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam UC", EWAC Jegan is now available in HGUCKit!

description.ja: 索敵用機器を備えた、偵察仕様の機体形状を新規造形で再現！
description.en: Reproduce the reconnaissance specification aircraft shape with enemy search equipment with new modeling!

description.ja: ● 頭部、センサー・ユニットを、新規造形で再現！
description.en: ● The head and sensor unit are reproduced with new modeling!

description.ja: 特徴的な頭部、および大型センサー・ユニットを新規造形で再現。
description.en: The characteristic head and large sensor unit are reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: 大型センサー・ユニット起動時のカラーリングは、ホイルシールで再現。
description.en: The coloring when the large sensor unit is activated is reproduced with foil Seal.

description.ja: ● 腕部ユニット等、本体形状を各所再現！
description.en: ● Reproduce the body shape in various parts, such as the arm unit!

description.ja: 右腕に装着されたカメラ・ユニット、左腕に装備されたセンサー・ユニットのほか、襟部、腰部を新規造形で再現！
description.en: In addition to the camera unit attached to the right arm and the sensor unit attached to the left arm, the collar and waist are reproduced with new modeling!

description.en: ・Collar part

description.ja: 形状の異なる襟部分は新規パーツを使用。
description.en: New parts are used for the collar part with a different shape.

description.ja: 右腕に装着されたカメラ・ユニットは、スコープ部分に専用のジュエルシールを使用し、リアルな質感を表現。
description.en: The camera unit attached to the right arm uses a special jewel seal for the scope part, giving it a realistic texture.

description.ja: 腰部分には新規パーツを使用して、武装を懸架可能。
description.en: Arms can be suspended using new parts at the waist.

description.ja: ● 遊びの幅が広がる、豊富な武装が付属！
description.en: ● Comes with a variety of weapons that expand the range of play!

description.en: Attached weapons: Beam rifle (2 types) / Hyper bazooka / Bazooka / Beam saber / Seal
